ARCHIVE_METHOD.REDIRECT_POLICY: A 302 to a different capture is NOT_OBTAINED; the target capture is used only under its own timestamp.

CANONICAL_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.PAGE_TITLE: Schedule of Releases for the Consumer Price Index
CANONICAL_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.PUBLISHER: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (first party)

EXCLUSIONS: Releases scheduled in 2025/2026 (incl. reference period 2024-12): OUT_OF_RANGE_INVENTORY.json, metadata only.
No CPI index values, percent changes, consensus, or surprises.
No BTC or other market data; no event-window returns.

CURRENT_SCHEDULE_PAGE.USE: Current first-party reference; retrieved after all windows; never point-in-time authority.

RELEASE_ARCHIVE_PAGE.USE: Realized-date consistency diagnostic only; never point-in-time authority.

POINT_IN_TIME_RULE: For window W in {6h,12h,24h}: SAFE_FOR_W iff the latest obtained capture with timestamp strictly before T-W lists the reference period with exactly the final pre-window schedule (date and local time), and no capture at/after T-6h contradicts it. SAFE_FOR_W24 => SAFE_FOR_W12 => SAFE_FOR_W6 enforced by conjunction. The realized release timestamp is never used to establish safety.
SCOPE: CPI release SCHEDULE metadata only. No CPI values. No market data. No outcomes.
SERIES_NOTE: BLS Consumer Price Index news release (CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items) schedule.

TIMEZONE_AUTHORITY.OFFICIAL_LOCAL_TIME_SOURCE: Release Time column of the archived BLS schedule page (Eastern Time)
TIMEZONE_AUTHORITY.RULE: EDT (UTC-04:00) if second-Sunday-March <= date < first-Sunday-November, else EST (UTC-05:00)
